// APPLICATION LAYER · WEB3, STRICTLY com.engine · Kotlincom.engine · Kotlin

Sovereign social,
guaranteed by 主权社交，
由 physics物理法则 — not policies. 而非政策担保。

Engine is the always-online half of a physically-isolated pair. It holds your public key and fingerprint — never the private key. Every identity signature, from relay challenge-response to E2E signaling, is delegated across devices to the offline Vault. The relay only ever routes ciphertext. Engine 是物理隔离双端中永远在线的那一半。它只持有你的公钥与指纹 —— 从不持有私钥。从中继挑战应答到端到端信令，一切身份签名都跨设备委托给离线的 Vault。中继永远只路由密文。

01 / WHY PHYSICAL ISOLATION物理隔离

Most "encrypted" IM has a多数"加密"IM 的服务器是 single point of collapse单点溃堤

Typical encrypted chat puts routing and key custody in the same trust zone — breach the server, take the keys with the ciphertext. Engine ends the gamble the primitive way: the device that holds keys physically cannot reach the network. 传统加密聊天把"路由消息"和"保管密钥"塞进同一个信任域 —— 服务器一破，密钥密文一锅端。Engine 用最朴素的方式终结这场豪赌：让持钥的设备物理上无法联网。

✕ TYPICAL ENCRYPTED IM传统加密 IM

Keys and ciphertext, same room密钥与密文同居一室

  • ✕Server forwards messages and escrows keys / device fingerprints服务器既转发消息，又托管密钥与设备指纹
  • ✕One database leak = full conversation history一次拖库 = 全量会话历史泄露
  • ✕Accounts bind phone/email; identity can be subpoenaed账号绑定手机/邮箱，身份可被传唤
  • ✕Malicious apps can hijack IPC and forge signatures恶意 App 可抢答 IPC、伪造签名
VS
✓ ENGINE × VAULT

Keys physically offline, signatures delegated over air私钥物理断网，签名隔空委托

  • ✓Vault has no INTERNET permission; keys sealed in Keystore TEEVault 无联网权限，密钥封存 Keystore TEE
  • ✓Engine is pure-memory: no Room, no SQLite, no DataStoreEngine 纯内存：无 Room、无 SQLite、无 DataStore
  • ✓All identity signing crosses devices via signed IPC callbacks一切身份签名经带签名的 IPC 跨设备完成
  • ✓Relay is stateless: breach it, all you get is noise中继零状态：打穿它，得到的只有乱码
02 / ARCHITECTURE THE TRIO三件套

One device to talk,一台畅聊， one to guard一台守钥, one to carry，一台传信

Three components, each doing exactly one job. Engine is the social front-end; the relay is a stateless ciphertext postman; Vault (next page) is the offline safe that owns every secret. 三个组件各司其职：Engine 是社交前端；中继是无状态的密文邮差；Vault（下一页）是独占一切秘密的离线保险箱。

Engine

App A · online social
  • E2E chat端到端聊天 — ECDH agreement + AES-256-GCM, AAD-bound anti-replay —— ECDH 协商 + AES-256-GCM，AAD 绑定防重放
  • Pure memory纯内存 — kill the process, everything evaporates —— 杀掉进程，一切蒸发
  • Groups & gating群组与门禁 — 200-member cap, invite codes, approval queues —— 200 人上限、邀请码刷新、审批队列
  • Spark emojiSpark 表情 — 60 refined faces, ≈1KB each, one message, E2E direct —— 60 张精制小表情，单张 ≈1KB，一条消息端到端直达
  • DID profilesDID 档案 — identity fingerprint, searchable handle —— 身份指纹，可检索昵称
com.engine · INTERNET ✓ · persistence ✗

Relay Server中继服务器

Relay · stateless postman
  • Ktor + Netty WebSocket passthrough with challenge-response loginWebSocket 透传 + 挑战应答注册
  • Never parses payload从不解析载荷 — routes ciphertext frames by fingerprint only —— 只按指纹路由密文帧
  • Zero state, zero disk零状态零落盘 — restart wipes it clean; migrate = change DNS —— 重启即白纸，迁移只需改 DNS
  • Guardrails护栏 — 20 msg/s rate limit · 128KB frames · per-IP quotas —— 20 msg/s 限速 · 128KB 帧 · 单 IP 配额
  • Production生产拓扑 — localhost-only, TLS terminated by Nginx (wss://) —— 仅监听本机，Nginx 终结 TLS（wss://）
relay-server · Ktor 2.3.7 · zero accounts

Vault

App B · offline safe
  • No INTERNET permission无联网权限 — air-gap enforced by Android manifest —— 由 Android 清单强制的物理断网
  • Keystore (TEE) AES-256 encrypted, double-layer storageAES-256 加密，双层存储
  • Dynamic codes动态签名码 — ECDSA P-256, 8 digits, 30s lifetime —— ECDSA P-256，8 位，30 秒有效
  • QR import扫码导入 — optical channel, URI carries no private key —— 光学通道，URI 不含私钥
  • Biometric login指纹登录 — BiometricPrompt + signed callback —— BiometricPrompt + 签名回调
com.vault · INTERNET ✗ · TEE ✓
03 / PLAYGROUND LIVE LAB交互实验室

Don't read the spec —别看说明书， send one亲手发一条

Two simulated phones and a relay panel that faithfully replays Engine's protocol: watch plaintext become ciphertext, cross the relay as noise, and re-emerge verified on the other side. 两台模拟手机加一块中继面板，忠实复刻 Engine 的协议流程：围观明文如何变成密文、以乱码姿态穿过中继、再经验签在对面复原。

Every message is sealed with the ECDH session key under AES-256-GCM (AAD binds source/target/seq against replay). The relay sees frames; the receiver verifies the signature and checks monotonic seq before decrypting. 每条消息先经 ECDH 会话密钥 以 AES-256-GCM 加密（AAD 绑定 source/target/seq 防重放）。中继只见帧，接收端先验签并校验 seq 单调递增才解密。

05 / THREAT MODEL

Seven attacks,七种攻击， seven hard stops七道硬闸

Straight from the repo's v2 security model — each row is a deployed countermeasure, not a roadmap item. 直接摘自仓库 v2 安全模型 —— 每一行都是已部署的对策，而非路线图。

Threat威胁Countermeasure对策
Malicious app hijacks IPC恶意 App 抢答 IPCAll IPC delivered to explicit package names with signature-level custom permissions; no BROWSABLE entry points全部 IPC 显式包名投递 + signature 级自定义权限，入口无 BROWSABLE
Forged login / binding callbacks伪造登录/绑定回调Callbacks must carry ECDSA signature (sessionId‖status‖ts), verified against the bound public key within a ±120s window回调必须携带 ECDSA 签名（sessionId‖status‖ts），Engine 用绑定公钥验签 + ±120s 时间窗
Relay self-claimed identity中继自报身份/顶号Registration requires challenge-response: HELLO(fingerprint+pubkey) → CHALLENGE → HELLO_AUTH(signature)注册须完成挑战-应答：HELLO(指纹+公钥) → CHALLENGE → HELLO_AUTH(签名)
ECDH MITM key substitutionECDH 公钥中间人替换SIGNAL carries an identity signature; receivers accept keys only when the signature verifies and the fingerprint matchesSIGNAL 信令携带身份签名，接收端验签且指纹匹配才采纳
Message replay / transplantation消息重放/移植GCM AAD binds (source, target, seq); receivers enforce monotonically increasing seqGCM AAD 绑定 (source, target, seq) + 接收端 seq 单调递增校验
Identity drift身份漂移Bound public key persisted in Vault; second launch restores the same identity, never silently regenerates绑定公钥持久化于 Vault，二次启动恢复同一身份，绝不静默生成新身份
Resource abuse资源滥用Per-IP connection quotas, 20 msg/s rate limit, 128KB payload cap (40KB text / 48KB media), 30s auth timeout单 IP 连接配额 / 20 msg/s 限速 / 128KB 载荷上限（40KB 文本 / 48KB 媒体）/ 认证 30s 超时
06 / DEPLOY

A relay you can一个可以throw away随时扔掉 without consequences而无后果的中继

Because the relay holds nothing, its location is a performance decision, not a trust decision. The reference deployment parks it in Hong Kong for low East-Asia latency, behind Nginx TLS, bound to localhost only. 因为中继什么都不持有，选址只是性能决策，而非信任决策。参考部署将其放在香港以获得东亚低延迟，藏于 Nginx TLS 之后，仅监听本机。

① LOCALHOST-ONLY LISTEN仅监听本机Relay binds 127.0.0.1:8080; port 8080 is firewalled from the public internet.中继只绑定 127.0.0.1:8080，8080 端口对公网防火墙隔离。
② NGINX TLS TERMINATIONNGINX 终结 TLSwss:// exposed via reverse proxy; debug builds allow ws://, release enforces wss:// only.经反向代理对外暴露 wss://；debug 包放行 ws://，release 强制 wss://。
③ SYSTEMD HARDENINGSYSTEMD 加固Dedicated relay user, NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp, auto-restart.专用 relay 用户、NoNewPrivileges、ProtectSystem=strict、PrivateTmp、自动重启。
④ ZERO-LOCK-IN MIGRATION零锁定迁移No state, no disk, no accounts — moving the relay is a DNS record change.零状态、零落盘、零账号 —— 迁移中继等于改一条 DNS 记录。
SPARK ECONOMY BUDGETSSPARK 经济预算 Message budgets are set by SparkEconomy: 40KB text, 48KB media, 128KB envelope ceiling, 200-member groups derived from a 100Mbps relay. The fuel metaphor is literal — every expressive byte rides Spark. 消息预算由 SparkEconomy 决定：40KB 文本、48KB 媒体、128KB 信封上限、由 100Mbps 中继推导的 200 人群组。"燃料"不只是比喻 —— 每一个表达的字节都由 Spark 承载。
